verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a session-level stealth mode with anti-detection techniques, plus a more advanced 'Ultra Stealth Mode', for sites with bot protection. Proxy routing is documented for reaching geo-restricted content, rotating IPs, and spreading requests across locations. One community user reported being instantly blocked by Cloudflare, but it is unclear whether stealth was enabled, so this lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. missing for 10: explicit documentation of residential proxy pools and country/city-level geo-targeting options, independent hands-on corroboration that stealth evades bot detection.
